responsibility: This definition module declares basic string-oriented console I/O procedures built on the default character streams. It belongs to the gm2 text I/O utility layer and exports ReadString for line-style input into ARRAY OF CHAR buffers, WriteString for writing nul-terminated strings, and WriteLn for emitting a line ending.
same_name_distinction: Interface half of the StrIO pair: it declares the small string-oriented I/O API—ReadString, WriteString, and WriteLn—while the implementation file contains the terminal editing, echo, and character-by-character stream handling.
